model_annotation: The graph displays the training loss over iterations for five different models: Vanilla, StrmLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H), SepLLM (n=64, H/T), and SepLLM (n=128). The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration," ranges from 0 to 140,000 with major gridlines and labels at intervals of 20,000, representing the number of training iterations. The y-axis, labeled "Loss," ranges from 2.4 to 3.4, with major gridlines and labels at intervals of 0.1. All five models start with a high loss value of approximately 3.3 at iteration 0 and show a general decreasing trend as the number of iterations increases. The "Vanilla" model (purple line) starts at the highest loss and shows a rapid initial decrease before leveling off. The "StrmLLM (n=64)" (blue line) and "SepLLM (n=64, H)" (green line) models follow a similar trajectory, starting slightly lower than Vanilla and decreasing steadily. The "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" (red line) and "SepLLM (n=128)" (dark blue line) models start at a loss of approximately 3.1 and exhibit the most consistent and steep decline, ending at the lowest loss values of around 2.5 by iteration 140,000. The "SepLLM (n=128)" model consistently maintains the lowest loss across the entire range of iterations shown.
